text: Send messages programmatically via a documented public API
quote: The Poke API allows you to send messages programmatically from your applications, scripts, and automation tools.

text: External services like GitHub, CI/CD, and monitoring tools can trigger Poke via webhooks/events
quote: Services like GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, or monitoring tools can trigger Poke when something happens.

text: Supports MCP servers so Poke can be extended with custom tools and data sources
quote: Poke supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, allowing you to extend Poke with custom tools and data sources.

text: Official CLI lets you log in and tunnel a local MCP server for development
quote: npx poke@latest tunnel http://localhost:3000/mcp -n "Local Dev MCP"

text: Creators earn revenue when users install and use their MCP recipes
quote: you earn revenue from MCP usage by users who install your recipe

text: Connect third-party apps and services (integrations) so Poke can access info and act across them via conversation
quote: Integrations let you connect your favorite apps and services to Poke. Once connected, Poke can access information and perform actions across apps and services through natural conversation.

text: Can merge two separate accounts into one
quote: This lets you combine both accounts into one.

text: Users can purchase additional usage credits to restore full limits
quote: Buy more credits any time from your subscription page to bring back full Ultra limits right away.

text: Can dispatch real human workers to complete real-world tasks like reservations, calls, and orders
quote: Poke can now bring in real people to take on tasks with a human touch - restaurant reservations, phone calls, placing orders, booking rides, and more.

text: Can create and deploy websites hosted at a personal yourname.poke.com subdomain
quote: Poke can also create and deploy websites for you at yourname.poke.com.

text: Users can set up a dedicated @poke.com email address linked to their primary account
quote: You can now set up a @poke.com address to use with your primary email account in Poke.

text: Verified AI product available natively inside Apple Messages
quote: Poke is now available on Apple Messages as the first and only AI product to be verified on the platform.

text: Available on Telegram as an alternative messaging channel to WhatsApp
quote: Poke now works with Telegram as an alternative to WhatsApp while it is temporarily unavailable (except in Italy and Brazil).

text: Integrates with Webflow for visual website design and deployment
quote: Webflow - Design and deploy websites visually
